name: Returning Fang
description: One homing blade returns and instantly relaunches. Attack speed increases blade speed; extra projectiles increase damage. One Ninja stance per run.

name: Barrage
description: +65% attack speed, -40% damage, +2 projectiles. One Ninja stance per run.

name: Great Shuriken
description: Throw a large, piercing shuriken with repeat hits. +50% damage, -50% attack speed, -55% projectile speed. Extra projectiles increase size. One Ninja stance per run.

name: Cutting Return
description: The returning blade damages each enemy once.

name: Relentless Fang
description: Consecutive outbound hits on one enemy gain +15% damage, up to +75%.

name: Final Pursuit
description: On a kill, the blade strikes one nearby enemy before returning.

name: Crescendo
description: Every 3 attacks add 1 temporary projectile. At the cap, the next attack restarts the buildup. Cap: 5, +2 per extra rank.

name: Needle Rain
description: Every 4th volley fires twice as many projectiles.

name: Serrated Edge
description: Repeat shuriken hits on one enemy gain +15% damage, up to +75%.

name: Grinding Halt
description: The shuriken briefly slows on its first hit against an elite or boss.

name: Growing Shuriken
description: The shuriken grows as it travels, reaching double size after 1000 cm.

name: Breaking Wheel
description: When the shuriken expires, scatter 6 blades dealing 30% hit damage each.

name: Embedded Blades
description: Projectile hits embed blades, including killing hits. On death, scatter them for 40% of their hit damage. Stores up to 12 blades; scattered blades cannot embed.

name: Barbed Blades
description: Embed 1 additional blade per hit, per rank.

name: Forking Projectiles
description: Projectiles fork on hit into 2 projectiles dealing 50% damage each. Forked projectiles cannot fork again.
